features.title: Strong frame built to last
features.text: Crafted from durable rubberwood, our frame offers reliable strength & lasting support for everyday lounging & unwinding.

features.title: Easy-care PVC for effortless upkeep
features.text: Smooth PVC upholstery resists stains & wipes clean easily — perfect for busy homes or quick refreshes.

features.title: Clean stitching for a refined touch
features.text: Defined stitching lines enhance the sofa’s sleek look, adding subtle detailing that elevates its simple, modern design.

features.title: Soft foam cushions for daily comfort
features.text: Plush foam cushions offer gentle support, so you can sink in comfortably whether you’re binge-watching or hosting friends.

features.title: Compact design for smaller rooms
features.text: Thoughtfully sized for apartments & cosier rooms, our wardrobe delivers full comfort without taking over your space.
